job: Change the whole look of the product live: palette, type, tone, density, corners and motion.
purpose: A floating, non-modal panel with controls for fifteen palettes, twelve type sets, tone (hue, vivid, light, warmth), theme, density, corners, lines, text size, contrast, motion and texture. Choices are saved in localStorage and applied before first paint when fire/boot.js loads. Copy CSS and Copy theme export the look. On phones it is a bottom sheet.
useWhen: A team is choosing a product's character before committing to it.
Users may tune density, contrast and motion for themselves.
